# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands (as of Oct 27, 2026)

**My pick: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall after testing 30+ models. It charges an iPhone at 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, with an AirPods spot on the base. The pad tilts and supports landscape StandBy. The power supply is included and the warranty is 2 years. WIRED lists it at $109, with a sale price of $98, $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. Prices change, so check at checkout.

## Other good options
- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169).** It does Qi2 25W for iPhone and has a heavy, premium base. The power adapter isn't included. You need a 40W one, such as Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter at $25.
- **Budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station (about $40 on sale, normally $80).** It's Qi2-certified at 15W, and the charger and cable are included. The Apple Watch charger is a separate slot-in unit, and the warranty is only 1 year.
- **Flat or bedside: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130).** Your devices can lie flat or pop up for StandBy. It supports Qi2 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow, so it's best used overnight.
- **Travel and desk: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99).** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand, and it includes a 45W adapter. It's heavier than other folding chargers at 399g.
- **Cheaper travel options:** Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (about $80 on sale, 15W) and ESR CryoBoost 25W ($99.99). ESR's CryoBoost has a quiet fan that you can turn off.

## Quick advice
- 25W Qi2 only applies to iPhone 16 and 17 series. Other iPhones get 15W. WIRED notes the faster speed makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin or ESR is enough for most people.
- Your AirPods case must support wireless charging.

## Where to buy
- Belkin, Nomad, ESR, Nimble and Anker: WIRED's guide has current shop links: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/
- Anker, ESR CryoBoost and Satechi: WIRED's travel guide has shop links: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/
- Satechi review, which has price links: https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html
- ESR CryoBoost 25W, with a tested code: https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand. Dealectric reported that code PARTNER18 took 18% off in ESR's cart on Oct 25, bringing it to about $82. This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission. Codes can change, so confirm at checkout.
